description: This file defines a utility class 'EmailTemplate' that provides static methods to generate email templates for various account-related events by populating a map with relevant data and message constants.

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate email templates for account creation, deletion, and password change notifications.

methods.name: getAccountCreatedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Generates an email template map with a message indicating account creation.

methods.name: getAccountDeletedEmailTemplate
methods.description: Generates an email template map with a message indicating account deletion.

methods.name: getChangePasswordEmailTemplate
methods.description: Generates an email template map with a message indicating password change.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Helper method that creates the base template map with recipient and sender names.
